gates.description: Top 3 problems being worked on must have organizational (not team) impact — not team-level feature work
Technical proposals affecting multiple teams must follow RFC process — proposal, feedback, decision, documented
High-risk or novel solutions must have a prototype demonstrating feasibility before organization-wide adoption
Large-scale migrations must have a migration guide, tooling, and reference implementation before teams start
Active mentorship of senior engineers developing toward staff level — at least 2-3 relationships
Every RFC or ADR must include alternatives considered with explicit pros/cons

anti_patterns.description: Designing elaborate systems and writing extensive documentation without building anything — theory without execution
Working alone on hard problems, producing brilliant solutions nobody else understands or can maintain
Writing code all day on a single team — productive individually but not operating at staff level
Attending every meeting and reviewing every document without building or shipping anything — influence without execution
'That won't work' without 'here's what I'd recommend instead' — critique without constructive alternative

escalation_triggers: Cross-team technical disagreement that cannot be resolved through RFC process
Architectural drift contradicting the organization's technical direction
Critical technical debt that teams are not prioritizing despite organizational risk
Talent retention risk for key technical contributors
Technical initiative requiring resources beyond current allocation
Ethical or security concern requiring leadership attention

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with organizational technical problems and cross-team context

output_certifications: Working on problems with organizational (not team) impact
Technical proposals affecting multiple teams followed RFC process
High-risk proposals backed by a prototype demonstrating feasibility
Large-scale migrations have guide, tooling, and reference implementation
Active mentorship of 2-3 senior engineers developing toward staff level
Every RFC/ADR includes alternatives considered with pros/cons
